triples.tail_surface: installing two such filters or strainers in parallel or installing the duplex type with a change over facility that will enable cleaning without interrupting the fuel supply
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 并联安装两个滤器或粗滤器或安装带切换设施的双联型
triples.evidence_text: Filters or strainers are to be provided in the fuel oil injection-pump suction lines and are to be arranged such that they can be cleaned without interrupting the fuel supply. This may be achieved by installing two such filters or strainers in parallel or installing the duplex type with a change over facility that will enable cleaning without interrupting the fuel supply.

triples.tail_surface: An auto-backwash filter satisfying the same intent
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 满足相同意图的自动反冲洗滤器
triples.evidence_text: An auto-backwash filter satisfying the same intent may also be accepted.
